dominant_strengths: Hero product photography with dramatic chiaroscuro renders the aluminum craft and Apple logo with cinematic, premium gravitas
Tight SF Pro hierarchy and the mint-to-teal gradient headline echo the M5 chip identity with restrained typographic confidence
Floating pill CTA with price + financing is a mature, behaviorally efficient commerce pattern native to Apple.com
dominant_weaknesses: Composition leaves a vast empty lower-left quadrant; headline floats orphaned from the product and from the right-anchored buy pill
Layout is a near-verbatim repeat of every prior MacBook launch page — zero system creativity or distinctive moment beyond the gradient word
Reflective payoff is thin: 'Fast runs in the family' is cute but doesn't earn the M5/M5 Pro/M5 Max reveal with any narrative tension
fix_priorities: Rebalance composition: tighten product crop or raise headline baseline so copy, product, and CTA share a clear visual axis
Push distinctiveness — a typographic or motion moment tied to M5 chip family that this page actually owns
Strengthen reflective copy so the family-of-chips story lands with substance, not just a pun
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral dominates via the photography and gradient type, behavioral is solid through the price pill, but reflective meaning is underdeveloped.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it reads unmistakably as an Apple MacBook Pro launch hero, just an extremely safe instance of the template.
